control_purpose: Test whether frame averaging and fitted theta derotation suppress shared overlap information.
boundary_assumption: Finite single-frame periodic FFT and circular-delay approximation; endpoint mismatch can spread spectral energy.
frequency_model: Nominal cycles fcB*Tb-fcA*Ta, q=round(cycles), frac=cycles-q, B*=exp(+j2pi*frac*u).
limitations: Nominal translation does not establish independent LO phase/frequency, valid CFO, or a common physical emission source. Single-frame SNR also differs from averaged templates.

cases.fractional_translation_formula: B(u)*exp(+j*2*pi*frac*u), for both train and heldout
cases.template_timing_source_a: AM lag linear fit on training frames 0:7; training residual <1 sample
cases.template_timing_source_b: AM lag linear fit on training frames 0:7; training residual <1 sample
cases.dc_subtraction_inherited: Fixed first-frame complex mean removed during template construction; not refitted here.

alignment.second_peak_ratio_definition: second outside mainlobe / first coarse peak
alignment.delay_identifiability: modulo one period; single-tone and comb aliases can remain
alignment.phase_reference: relative B to A on training overlap; no absolute physical RF phase
alignment.scope: No CFO/rate fitting, crossover synthesis, or image-based registration

alignment.branch_selection_criterion: maximum training complex coherence after fractional refinement

synthesis.frequency_coordinate_caveat: Hz fields use supplied integer centers/T; upstream mapping owns the common Floquet offset and absolute RF reference
synthesis.output_spectrum_convention: fftshift FFT/N; positive analytic, no conjugate mirror
synthesis.coefficient_scaling: Fourier-series coefficients preserved; time waveform is ifft(ifftshift(Y))*Nout
synthesis.source_lr_caveat: Sequential zero-phase W8 on source Fs_filter=2B, sampled on power2 synthesis grid; absent-band attenuation retained, no renormalization
